description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering timesheet search parameters, including date ranges and employee number, within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DefaultTimesheetSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for encapsulating search filters for timesheet queries, including optional date bounds and employee number.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date filter for timesheet search, if set.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date filter for timesheet search.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date filter for timesheet search, if set.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date filter for timesheet search.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the search filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the search filter.
